The rules of the module are [P/01.1 N0](../../01-store/spec/01.1-store.norms.md#n0-vocabulary).

Use exactly one marker reread before silent.
A changed marker with no exact fresh generation is temporarily unconfirmed: defer the derived snapshot and use existing 503 unavailable on a door requiring the confirmed read, not a new member state.
The process writes objects by the queue rule of\n[chapter 8.10](08.10-domain.norms.md) N1.7 `objects`.
The fields of the view of other chapters (`books`, `pending`, `outcomes`, `term`,\n`shared`) the process writes in the same pass.

The pass reads `domain/member-rows/<part>` — the list of members (owner — chapter\n8.3).
The pass reads the copies of the members by the mark `reported` and the generation ([P/08.3 N1.3](08.3-domain.norms.md) and N3 «read the copy»).
Which member is the holder is a decision of deployment (chapter 8.8), not the order of installation.
The domain reads a member only by its copy, it does not go to the member itself.
The epoch of a unit is monotonic in its cluster ([P/03.2 N1.5](../../03-worker/spec/03.2-worker.norms.md)); the domain needs no issuer of epochs.
`siblings`: at one member several units can carry one ref: the main one and the other records of a camera.
Which of the `siblings` is the main one the domain does not judge: that is a word of the subsystem.
For a manifest without `domain.ref`, the door `/domain/<sub>/<rows>` — 404.
A unit row without a value of the field `domain.ref` takes nothing from the completeness of the view.
The heartbeat of a unit without a value of the field `domain.ref` goes into the member's report all the same.
This process's first look at a heartbeat is a change in any state of the member (the age of the\nheartbeat counts from it).

After a restart of the same holder the marks of the members remain in its store, but the first look at a mark is not a change: a member with\na mark is `unseen`, the view is incomplete, until the process sees a change.
A live member updates its mark at least every LOST_AFTER/2 (chapter 8.3 N1.3)\nand comes to `ok` no later than this term.

A member that died before the restart becomes `silent` after LOST_AFTER. So it does not look\nalive after the restart, and an edit of chapter 8.6 on its unit answers 503 «not heard», not 404 «nowhere».
There is no new window «from old memory».
`Unit.age` has one digit after the point.
`Unit.labels` and `Unit.about` serve the judgement by target (the rights contract), so that the view is filtered no coarser than the console.
In `Unit.view` there are no secret fields (P/06.2 N1.4).
The heartbeat is unreadable — `Unit.status` as if there is no element.
A unit in the heartbeats of two workers\nof one member — two elements (both carry it; the shadow report sorts out which of them acts).
The role of an executor\n(main or reserve) is the concern of the subsystem, the view does not show it.
With `executors`, the completeness of the view — by N3 step 5.
Tables do not enter `domain/view`: the view is written every 3 s, and tables change rarely.
A dispute of `ref` (`contested`) does not remove the rows of tables: a row is addressed by the cluster and the key.
The object `domain/members/<member>/tables/<sub>/<table>` is the snapshot of P/04 N1.3b from the member's copy as is; cluster equals the member's name.
The fields of a table of `domain.view_tables` — from its fields\nor unit.fields, not *_secret, not blob, held_by — only for the table of places (P/02.1, relations 137–143).
`manifest`: the key `domain.view_status` of the manifest — N1.4 Unit status.

An error of the removal of the objects of a member that left — the next pass.
A row of a part is written only on a difference, so the worker on the domain reads the part that changed as_of.
A part is a unit of work, the list of non-empty ones is parts of the head, round = members / budget; a row is written only on a difference.
After a change of the holder and a start of the process `complete` is false until the round is closed.
A row of domain/ref-claims with two members is a dispute.
domain/shadow is written once per round.
With a small domain the round is shorter than VIEW_EVERY and all is as before.
A short list MUST NOT\nbe passed off as a complete one.
«Not found» in a complete answer is a fact about the domain; in an incomplete one — a fact about the network: the refusal names who\nwas not heard (N4).
Every derivative of the copies carries its own list of the absent.
`claim`: ref — by the id of the unit from the snapshot shard of this member; an element without ref (no row in the shard) — no claim.
An element not in the form of P/03.4 N1.1 (epoch, revision, observed_revision are not integers, etc.) — no claim.
An element phase: unreadable (the epoch is not taken, P/03.3 N3 step 2) — no claim.
Before SHADOW_STALL has run out for `orphaned` there is no finding (the member's controller has not placed yet).
An equal greatest epoch at two workers on one unit (the same id) — conflict; different ids of one ref are different units (N1.2 siblings), not a dispute.
The findings lagging and stalled — only for acting claims.
A placement is\nthe triple (sub, ref, cluster): a change of the target and a return to the former one — a new placement, the count anew.
SHADOW_STALL for class camera — max(60, 3 × every of the mark) (P/08.3 N1.1a).
Both counts of SHADOW_STALL — from this process's first look\nat the pair or the placement, in any state of the member.
The count has run out — the time is strictly greater than SHADOW_STALL: at exactly SHADOW_STALL it has not (both counts).
A placement on a member that is not `ok` is not orphaned but unknown\n(`unknown` in findings, it does not enter the count of failures).
In the module the domain does not place by itself\n(the placement is written by the operator, chapter 8.6).
In `domain/view.trust`, root and book_seal are fingerprints (P/08.2 N1.1 fingerprint).
In `domain/view.relay_refused`, refused is empty — there is no key of the relay (not {}).
An accepted packet of a relay does not change the other relays in `domain/view.relay_refused`.
`domain/view.relay_refused` is the memory of the process — after a restart the field is empty.
The content of the doors `GET /domain`, `GET /domain/<sub>/<rows>`, `GET /domain/shadow` is N1.4,\nN1.6 of this chapter.
The command `view` of an implementation («Implementation decides» item 1): the input is a file of passes (N5), the output is the JSON `{view, shadow}` of the last\npass.

The command `view` is the same function as the holder's pass, without the store.

In the input of the command, a server keeps the ordinary first-look `unseen` rule until an observed mark change.
No class or receipt field is inferred from the copy’s objects.
